title: Quantum Zeta Functions for Mirror Calabi–Yau Threefolds
exact_target: Construct arithmetic mirror invariants with the expected duality while retaining the important motive information lost by simple zeta-function ratios.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000479 (OWR-1270-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mini-Workshop: Zeta Functions, Index and Twisted K-Theory; Interactions with Physics (2006), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2006/21, pp. 1245--1284; official report source and mathematical context.

Zeta functions of alternate mirror Calabi-Yau families; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: Quantum zeta function and quantum L-series are requested notions, not uniquely defined inputs. The report's ratio candidate has the desired duality but discards the weight-motive factor; its explicit orbifold results are context, not a universal construction for all Calabi--Yau mirror pairs.
